event: The party leaves the Floor 21 rest node before the Tower's morning shift.
Dayo signals formation three; Tomás goes out with Eagle Eye at full reach.
Solenne carries the Architect document, its legible parts read three times.
Its untranslatable sections are in a different writing system entirely.
Floor 22 opens wider than Floor 21, with a longer reverberation.
Two Hollow Wardens in the first section; the formation brings them down.
Vesper examines a Warden's joint: the same construction as Floors 20 and 21.
Same as every floor, she says, rechecked against her catalog.
Miriam says the Builder built the Wardens; Vesper says or the same documentation.
Dayo says something built this place to challenge them and to let them through.
Nobody answers; the formation moves on.
At the second rest pause, Solenne says she wants to read them something.
She reads: six bearers, each one Aspect in full, the Harmony architecture's maximum.
The six Aspects map to six functions for Composite operation at the Summit.
It is not a test of capability; it is a mechanism for becoming.
Solenne realises the pre-System stone frequency has been doing something all along.
Tomás repeats it: a mechanism for becoming, not a test.
Miriam says the Proving Gate trials were specific to each bearer.
Nadia says the notice board foretold what the Tower was going to make happen.
Dayo says they were always going to become this.
Solenne says the document only says the mechanism maximizes the probability.
Dayo says it doesn't change the choices: they still made them.
Dayo walks back into formation, still answering to herself.
Tomás warns of large presences ahead, stationary, already arranged.
Solenne's Conductor reads signals she has no catalog entry for.
Seven Greybacks stand in a loose arc at the far side of the widening.
Arcane Analysis reads The Organized: non-hostile unless provoked, no level.
Dayo stops the formation at the entrance; the two groups regard each other.
The central Greyback turns its head toward a cache by the wall near Nadia.
The cache holds odd stone fragments, a spent Core and folded material.
Solenne's Conductor reads the Greyback as present, watching them a long while.
Nadia says it wants them to look at the cache.
Tomás says wants is a large word; Nadia says it's the right one anyway.
Tomás walks to the cache unarmed and crouches to examine it without touching.
He says the fragments are cut joint sections: they've been watching them fight.
The Greyback makes a structured sound; the other six shift in confirmation.
Nadia says they know the joint section; they've been studying the same thing.
Vesper says they've been here the whole time.
Tomás documents the cache; the party passes through taking nothing.
The Greybacks do not follow, still watching the corridor entrance.
At the Floor 22 rest node, Dayo asks if Vasic said how many reached the Summit.
Solenne says no; Dayo says Vasic would know.
Tomás says the System is under two years old and nobody's confirmed above Floor 70.
Dayo wants Vasic's record: there may have been earlier attempts.
Miriam writes in her clinical notebook without stopping; Nadia watches her hand.
Solenne says they will ask Vasic the next time she finds them.
Tomás says she will; she's been finding them since Floor 11.
Dayo reads the floor completion: eight floors to the Section 30 boundary.
Eight floors before they must decide on the Floor 21 Composite lock.
Dayo says they'd better keep moving.
Nadia opens her skill window again and accepts it.
She acquires Clear Note, Tier II Brightspirit, and says nothing.
Solenne runs the Conductor on all six and begins a new catalog entry.
